description:
Parent: fz-kdt.13

Story 3 of fz-kdt.13 Strategy v3 (cold-reviewed). Blocked by fz-kdt.13.1.

One derivation per CallSiteKey owning that callsite's CallSiteSummary/
CallSiteTargets/Activation/ActivationInputs; one whole-body derivation owning
ReturnType/ActivationAnalyzed and reading everything (absorbs define_return's
hidden ascents state). A callsite derivation's read set = the prefix of the
existing dataflow-ordered reads vector (semantic.rs:106, threaded through the
walk) captured at emission time, PLUS all post-coalescing reads
(rebuild_coalesced_call_emission and contract reads fold into the affected
sets), PLUS completion-time reads (normalize_contributions reads body_keying/
dispatch_masks -- attribute to every derivation or whole-body). Shift causes
dirty all derivations. Blocked runs mark only unreached derivations dirty.

Soundness property test: recomputing a callsite derivation with its recorded
read set held fixed reproduces its outputs (catches a too-early watermark).

## Checks
- Facts settle mid-drive: ActivationInputs/Activation/callsite facts reach
  settled before the drain rather than at it (count from work_graph.quiesced
  by kind).
- AnalyzeActivation evals ratchet on the three fixtures (post-kdt.63 bases:
  1,081 CLI-lens on take_drop_split); backend inventory pins (59/221/214)
  hold or drop.
- Zero-uncaused unweakened; determinism suite green; matrix green.
- Re-measure the pop-time ready-alternative rate afterward (Story 4's gate).

## BLOCKED BY

- ○ fz-kdt.13.1 P1 Publisher identity becomes (Job, DerivationId) in the one ledger

## Obligations inherited from fz-kdt.13.1's adversarial review

- FIRST RED TEST: the JobEffects::derivations -> DerivationEffects bridge at
  world.rs:490-497 is entirely unexercised at 13.1 (nothing constructs a
  JobDerivation). Cover it with a World-level test passing a second
  derivation BEFORE any semantic use.
- The recompute-with-fixed-read-set soundness property test (a callsite
  derivation's outputs are reproducible from its recorded reads) must land
  WITH this ticket, not after: a fact published by a clean derivation stays
  settled while its job is queued to re-run whole, and frontier retirement
  (world.rs:499-503, a named wrong-compile site) consumes that settledness.
- FOOTGUN (documented in withdraw_unreported_derivations): a concluding run
  withdraws every derivation it does not re-report -- analyze_activation must
  re-report EVERY callsite derivation it still owns on each conclusion
  (fz-kdt.63's preserved_analysis_claims logic is the model).
- CONTRACT: each derivation owns its own keys (no key co-published by two
  derivations of one job) -- the engine does not enforce key-disjointness;
  the derivation author does. Derivation withdrawal carries no changed
  channel, so a derivation must own only keys whose content is entirely its
  own contribution.
- Non-waiting completions COERCE concluded=true per derivation (13.1's F1
  fix): a blocked run is the only way to leave a derivation dirty.
title: analyze_activation reports derivations by read watermark
